description: Canonical required-token manifest (master plan §3.6.1): the base shadcn set plus the semantic part vocabulary every theme's tokens.css must declare under [data-ww-theme="<slug>"]. Groups marked themeScoped MUST be declared on the scope element itself (not inherited from :root); other groups only need to resolve non-empty. T1 theme waves port values from the design stylesheets against this list; the token-completeness probe enforces it.

base.description: Base shadcn surface tokens (globals.css :root provides fallbacks; themes may override).

fonts.description: Typography tokens (plan: --font-mono is required; --font-sans rides along).

severity.description: Canonical severity (§3.7): critical | warning | info — the D1 rename retired --sev-error/--sev-warn.

semantic.description: Semantic part vocabulary + chrome (§3.6): state, recency, pinning, eyebrow, chrome radius/hairline/panel background.

charts.description: One recharts engine token fills, --chart-1..6 (§3.6: the single recharts token-fill block).
